topics.topic: Imported constant or closed model value for the accepted JSON encoding policy
questions: Replace the prose reference to the encoding required by the JSON standard with the name of an imported constant or closed model enumeration that supplies the accepted encoding policy.
The note must name an imported constant that supplies the accepted encoding, rather than requiring the generator to infer a value from an unspecified JSON standard.
The required encoding must be placed in a provider constant, added to IMPORTS, and named as `the imported X constant` instead of being described indirectly.

quotes: _connections_file: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return content validated strictly against = models.ConnectionsFile only when it is one JSON text in the encoding the JSON standard requires, with no byte-order mark, in which no object repeats a member name, whose only member is objects, each key of objects the canonical lowercase hyphenated spelling of a UUID, and each value a ConnectionEntry with exactly its fields, each of its declared type without coercion; it MUST raise ValueError for any other content.
judgement.why: The note states the accepted encoding as the encoding required by the JSON standard; this is a behavioral validation condition, not an inline policy value requiring a provider constant or enumeration.

topics.topic: Permitted value source for the parent-folder segment spelling
questions: Name the parent-folder segment through an imported constant or another permitted value path instead of describing the required path token only in words.

The note must name an imported constant that supplies the forbidden parent-segment spelling or otherwise receive that value through one of the three permitted paths, rather than requiring the generator to guess what “names the parent folder” means.
The parent-folder segment value must be placed in a provider constant, added to IMPORTS, and named as `the imported X constant` instead of being described in words.

quotes: _subfolder: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return the value unchanged only when it is a string holding a non-empty relative path none of whose segments names the parent folder and which does not name the root itself, and MUST raise ValueError for any other value.
judgement.why: The note identifies the forbidden segment by its standard path meaning as the segment that names the parent folder; it does not leave a policy value to be supplied through a data provider.

quotes: read_mark: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None when _read_record gives None for _mark_path of the project id and source id, letting its DelivererError pass; otherwise it MUST return the PublicationMark those bytes hold only when they are one JSON text in the encoding the JSON standard requires, with no byte-order mark, valid against = models.PublicationMark with no extra field, whose project_id and source_id are the given ones, and MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns for any other content.

read_placement: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST return None when _read_record gives None for _placement_path of the project id and source id, letting its DelivererError pass; otherwise it MUST return the PhotoPlacement those bytes hold only when they are one JSON text in the encoding the JSON standard requires, with no byte-order mark, valid against = models.PhotoPlacement with no extra field, whose project_id and source_id are the given ones, and MUST raise the DelivererError _state_unavailable returns for any other content.

judgement.rule: Адрес, записанный без `=` — в обратных кавычках или словами, — не разыменовывается вовсе: до модели не доходит ни значение, ни символ, и она вынуждена значение сочинить. Обе формы невалидны для значения, которое читает генерируемый код.

topics.topic: Define and import a named constant or setting for valid TCP port bounds
questions: The TCP port bounds are a threshold policy that the generated code must read, so the note must name an imported constant containing those bounds, and that constant must be added to IMPORTS and the imported data access signatures.

The valid TCP-port boundary must be placed in imported provider constants (or an appropriate settings field), and the note must name those symbols instead of requiring the generator to infer the boundary from “one TCP cannot address”.
The port-validity boundary must be placed in an imported provider constant and the note must name that constant, rather than requiring the generator to infer which integer ports TCP can address.

quotes: load_config: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise ValueError when the port of the settings is one TCP cannot address or when the time zone database does not know their timezone, then MUST call the imported load_connections once with the connections_file of the settings as a Path, letting its DelivererError end the start, and MUST return DeliveryContext with binary_root, state_dir and connections_file of the settings as Path values and their timezone unchanged; it MUST NOT read the credential file.
judgement.why: The note makes generated code apply TCP port bounds without naming an imported constant or settings field that supplies that threshold value.
